inputs.prompt: Fixed camera, one continuous gothic anime shot continuing the supplied image. A small blue whale-cloak girl at LEFT holds the left tip of a log, a black-gold robed man at RIGHT supports the log in his left arm. In the first second, the man bends down, places his free right palm firmly against the girl's LEFT SHOULDER BELOW HER FACE, and pushes her shoulder backwards once. His hand never touches her head or hat. She immediately lets go of the log and stumbles backwards to the left: her left boot slides backward on the wet floor, her knees fold, her hips sink down. Her weight stays low. She falls onto her left knee and catches herself with both palms on the floor. Her boots drag on the floor throughout the fall. She never jumps or lifts both feet into the air. The shove, backward step and knee-hand landing happen in a single clear smooth motion with realistic weight. Her expression is frightened and sad, not smiling. During the last second she stays down on her hands and knees looking urgently up at the man, who retracts his pushing hand and carries the log toward the stairs at the rear. Preserve the exact costume details, character proportions, staircase, distant cross, blue windows, gold firelight and detailed Japanese gothic anime look. No change in camera angle. No elastic recoil, hopping, bowing, head patting, levitation, kicks or acrobatics. The log is carried steadily and never hits her.
